text:
rebecca: Quick sync — we just got a customer report that 1.9.9 occasionally drops a token when KV cache evicts during long prefixes. Looks like a regression from the recent cache refactor. I want to cut a minimal patch (1.9.9-a) today, no feature changes. Who can own branch + changelog?

zach: I can take the branch. Will aim for a single cherry-pick that reverts the offending commit. Can someone point to the exact commit hash?

maria: @zach I reproduced locally and it’s the commit 0f3c2b7 that adjusted eviction timing. Confirmed tests fail on sequence-length test.

amy: Quick CI check — if we revert that one change and run the regressions suite, should be green. I'll queue the full test run once branch is up.

zach: Ok creating branch now: `git checkout -b release/minor/1.9.9-a && git cherry-pick 0f3c2b7`

release-captain: Heads-up on release windows — ops prefers deploys in the next 2 hours. If we can get a build + smoke in ~45m we can push. Otherwise schedule for tomorrow morning.

sarah: I can prep the changelog blurb. Keep it short and explicit. Suggest: "Fix: avoid token drop during KV cache eviction on long prefixes (regression from cache refactor)." Want that in the Top-level changelog + changelog/1.9.x.md.

maria: +1 to that blurb. Also add a test note: `added regression test for prefix KV eviction` — helps QA.

rebecca: Nice. Please make sure to keep the diff minimal — only revert/apply the minimal hunks. No versioned config changes. Also tag the commit with `release: 1.9.9-a` so automation picks it up.

zach: Pushed branch: `release/minor/1.9.9-a` with cherry-pick + small adjustments. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8281

dev-bot: CI queued for PR #8281 — build 4527. Tests: unit, integration, regressions. Estimated time ~18m.

amy: I'll watch CI. If green I'll run the smoke deployment in staging and execute the prefix test.

ops-bot: Reminder: production deploy runbook requires sign-off from release-captain and at least one oncall present. Current oncall: @sarah.

release-captain: I can sign off if staging smoke + prefix regression pass. Keep me posted.

sarah: Oncall here — standing by. Amy ping me when smoke completes.

amy: CI green ✅. Staging smoke started.

rebecca: Thx. Maria, can you paste the changelog entry here so I can sanity-check language before we merge?

maria: Changelog snippet: ```
- 1.9.9-a — 2026-03-17
  - Fix: prevent token drop during KV cache eviction on long prefixes (regression from cache refactor)
  - Tests: add prefix-KV eviction regression test
```

zach: Added the changelog file `changelogs/1.9.x/1.9.9-a.md` and bumped package version to "version": "1.9.9-a" in the minimal bump commit. PR updated.

amy: Staging smoke passed ✅. Prefix regression test passes locally + in CI. Ready for prod.

release-captain: I reviewed the PR, diff is tiny, tests look good. Approving now.

sarah: I'll be available for deploy. Ops — please schedule push to production now.

ops-bot: Production deploy scheduled at 2026-03-17T15:30:00Z — pipeline: canary -> 10% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error.

rebecca: Thanks everyone. After deploy, please monitor token-drop alert for 1 hour and post results here. If no regressions we can merge changelog into mainline and close the branch.

zach: Deploy started. Will drop status updates in this thread.

dev-bot: Deploy step: canary started.

zach: Canary looks good at 10m. No error spikes, no token-drop traces in logs.

dev-bot: Canary -> 10% completed. Scaling to 100%.

zach: 100% rollout complete. No anomalies seen in the first 20m.

rebecca: Great work. I'm going to merge the changelog into main and delete the branch after 30m if no issues. :tada:

maria: Post-deploy check in 30m: logs look clean. Closing ticket on our side.

release-captain: Signed off final. Thanks team.

zach: Branch deleted. PR closed.

rebecca: Extra: add a tiny note to the internal release tracker referencing this thread: "1.9.9-a minimal revert for KV eviction — deployed 2026-03-17".

ops-bot: Monitoring alert cleared after 1h no incidents.

rebecca: Excellent. Back to normal cadence. If anything else pops up, re-open here. :white_check_mark:
